hero.subtitle: At YES TIME GLOBAL, we value transparency, fairness, and customer trust. Please review the applicable terms before submitting a refund or cancellation request.

card.label: Policy Process
card.title: Request Review
card.noteText: Requests are reviewed according to applicable terms.

transparent.title: Transparent Review
transparent.text: Every request is reviewed according to the applicable program terms and conditions.

timely.title: Timely Support
timely.text: Our team aims to guide you through the request and review process.

secure.title: Secure Handling
secure.text: Information submitted for verification is handled carefully during the review process.

support.title: Customer Support
support.text: We aim to handle valid requests professionally and respectfully.

commitment.title: Fair Policy. Clear Process.
commitment.subtitle: We aim to make refund and cancellation requests understandable, structured, and easy to submit.

process.title: Refund & Cancellation Guidelines
process.subtitle: Follow these steps when submitting a refund or cancellation request.

1.title: Check Program Terms
1.text: Refund and cancellation requests are handled according to the terms and conditions of the selected program or service.

2.title: Submit Your Request
2.text: Submit your refund or cancellation request through the company’s official support channel with complete and accurate information.

3.title: Provide Required Information
3.text: The company may require customer details, payment information, transaction records, and other supporting documents where necessary.

4.title: Verification
4.text: The submitted request and supporting information are reviewed and verified before a decision is made.

5.title: Approval & Processing
5.text: If the request meets the applicable conditions, the refund or cancellation will be processed according to the relevant program terms.

6.title: Refund Processing
6.text: Where a refund is approved, it will be processed through the applicable payment or banking method, subject to processing requirements.

information.title: Information You May Need
information.subtitle: Keeping the relevant information and supporting records ready can help make the review process easier.

customer.title: Customer Information
customer.text: Provide your name and relevant contact details associated with your program or transaction.

payment.title: Payment Details
payment.text: Payment or transaction information may be required to identify and verify the relevant payment.

record.title: Transaction Record
record.text: Where applicable, provide the receipt, payment record, reference number, or other transaction evidence.

reason.title: Reason for Request
reason.text: Clearly explain the reason for your refund or cancellation request so it can be reviewed properly.

programs.title: Different Programs, Different Requirements
programs.subtitle: Certain refund, cancellation, and transaction matters may require additional verification depending on the program.

bank.title: Bank Related Matters
bank.text: Refunds or payment related matters involving banking services may require transaction verification and compliance with the applicable banking process and terms.

property.title: Property Related Matters
property.text: Property related requests may require verification of the relevant agreement, transaction records, supporting documents, and applicable program conditions.

vehicle.title: Vehicle Related Matters
vehicle.text: Vehicle related requests may be reviewed against the relevant agreement, payment records, registration or transaction information, and applicable terms.

payment.title: Payment & Transaction Matters
payment.text: Payment related requests may require transaction verification and supporting records before any refund or adjustment can be considered.

processing.title: How an Approved Refund Is Processed
processing.subtitle: Once a request has been reviewed and approved, processing follows the applicable program, payment, or banking requirements.

review.title: Request Review
review.text: Your request and supporting information are reviewed against the applicable program conditions.

approval.title: Approval
approval.text: Eligible requests proceed according to the relevant terms and conditions.

payment.title: Payment Processing
payment.text: Where applicable, the approved refund is processed through the relevant payment or banking channel.

notes.1: Refund and cancellation requests are subject to the applicable terms and conditions of the selected program or service.
notes.2: The requester may be required to provide accurate personal, payment, transaction, or supporting information.
notes.3: The company may verify submitted information and request additional documentation where necessary.
notes.4: Approval of a request is not automatic and depends on the applicable eligibility and program conditions.
notes.5: Refund processing may depend on the relevant payment provider, bank, or other applicable service provider.
notes.6: Certain payments, charges, services, or transactions may not be eligible for refund according to the applicable terms.
notes.7: Requests involving property, vehicles, banking, or other specific services may be subject to additional requirements.
notes.8: For disputes or clarification, please contact the official support team for review.
notes.title: What to Keep in Mind

help.title: Need Help?
help.text: Our support team can guide you through eligibility, documentation, and request submission.

legal.title: Important Policy Notice
legal.p1: Refund and cancellation requests are considered according to the terms and conditions applicable to the relevant program, service, agreement, or transaction.
legal.p2: Submission of a request does not by itself guarantee approval. Requests may require verification of the information and supporting documents provided.
legal.p3: Where a request involves a bank, property, vehicle, or another third party service, additional terms, documentation, or procedures may apply.
legal.p4: If you have a question regarding the interpretation or application of this policy, please contact our support team before proceeding.

cta.title: Let our team help you with your request.
cta.subtitle: Contact YES TIME GLOBAL if you need clarification about refund eligibility, cancellation, or the required process.
